summary: Compares two DWORD-array objects field by field, short-circuiting on the first mismatch. Checks six DWORD fields at offsets 0x0, 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x1C and 0x20 in order; returns TRUE only if all six match. Fields between 0x10 and 0x18 and above 0x24 are not compared. Called by ShortComputation_9bf0 (0x00499BF0).

local_names.a2: right object pointer to compare against
local_names.result: conjunction of the six field equality tests

operations.description: Test this[0] == a2[0]; on mismatch short-circuit to FALSE.
Test this[1] == a2[1]; on mismatch short-circuit to FALSE.
Test this[2] == a2[2]; on mismatch short-circuit to FALSE.
Test this[3] == a2[3]; on mismatch short-circuit to FALSE.
Test this[7] == a2[7] (offset 0x1C); on mismatch short-circuit to FALSE.
Test this[8] == a2[8] (offset 0x20); on mismatch short-circuit to FALSE.
Return TRUE if all six field tests passed, otherwise FALSE.

unresolved: The meaning of the skipped region (offsets 0x10-0x18, 0x24+) is unknown; the function deliberately omits those fields.
Owner class identity is unknown; equality on six DWORDs does not identify a specific session object.
Whether the caller ShortComputation_9bf0 relies on ordering of the checks is unproven.
